org: The Media School, Indiana University Bloomington
name: High School Journalism Institute (HSJI)
what_you_do: A five day news workshop on the IU campus. Pick one topic for each session, such as social media, sports news, sports broadcasting, photos or yearbook. You learn from pros.
who_can_apply: High school students. Beginners and experienced students are both welcome. Age limits are not stated.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the pages read. Scholarships are available.
duration: 5 days per session (Session 1: July 12 to 16, 2027. Session 2: July 18 to 22, 2027)
deadline_text: 2027 sessions are July 12 to 16 and July 18 to 22. No deadline stated; registration link is on the page.
how_to_apply: Register online and choose one workshop per session. You can sign up for one or both sessions. Full workshops may have a waitlist.
notes: Run since 1946. Check the site for cost and dorm details before you plan.
